relationships.subject: miR-143-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: miR-143 plays an analgesic–inflammatory role by downregulating COX-2 (cyclooxygenase-2), an important enzyme in the production of pro-pain prostaglandins, through the degradation of its mRNA

key_findings: Chronic migraine patients had higher serum TNF-alpha, IL-6 and IL-17; miR-197-3p higher without aura and miR-143-3p higher in episodic migraine.
miR-101-3p correlated with IL-17 and HIT-6 in chronic migraine.
